question: What great attainment makes one dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation form a combined attainment
This attainment is described as a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment makes one dear to the yoginīs
inference: One who attains great accomplishment in both enjoyment and liberation becomes dear to the yoginīs.
plain_english: One may attain the great accomplishment of both enjoyment and liberation and become dear to the yoginīs.
